title: Storytelling Night—"CONFESSIONS"
description: **Our theme for May is CONFESSIONS** Truths spoken aloud. Truths written and never sent. Truths confessed too late—or too early. Give us stories of secrets revealed, apologies offered, feelings admitted, and words that changed the course of things. Confessions made out of love, fear, guilt, or necessity. **As always, interpret the theme freely.** **Please come just to listen or get on stage,** be vulnerable, and share with us, a diverse group of welcoming and open people who are curious about each others' lives. Stories will last from 7 to 10 minutes. Expect ten stories plus an intermission. **We will hold our event at Fábrica Braço de Prata,** an enormous multi-roomed centro cultural in Marvila that hosts everything from salsa bands to intimate piano concerts to philosophical comedy. To accommodate everyone, we will be in the outdoor tent right inside the gate to Fábrica Braço de Prata. Love is a popular edition, arrive early to get good seats. **Storytelling Lisboa is a completely free event run by volunteers.** We welcome everyone to get on stage! Absolutely no experience is necessary. We only ask that stories be true and personal and that they are performed as opposed to read—and they should be stories instead of philosophical musings, motivational speeches, or stand-up routines. The content is completely at the discretion of the storyteller as long as it is related in the monthly theme and respectful to the diversity and experiences of all humans. **Interested in sharing a story?** We give spots on a first come, first serve basis. Please fill out our form here: [https://forms.gle/kkGhEM47BLF4WRkg9](https://forms.gle/kkGhEM47BLF4WRkg9) **We now have an email list** to subscribe to keep up with events. You can [subscribe with this link](http://eepurl.com/iXpMeI). We also have [a WhatsApp Group ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/BpN6iJGSp8fCnzKA0TSRra)if you prefer to get updates directly to your phone! For any questions or concerns, reach out to us by DM on our instagram [@storytellinglisboa](https://www.instagram.com/storytellinglisboa)! Or email storytellinglisboa at gmail dot com. **Bring some cash to throw into our donation jar!** We will always be free and want everyone to be able to attend, but your funds help sustain the increasing effort and volunteers needed to put on the event. We also have a podcast if you want to enjoy stories from home called **[What Lingers.](https://www.instagram.com/whatlingerspod)** You can find it on all podcast platforms! All links related to Storytelling Lisboa can additionally be found on our linktree: [https://linktr.ee/storytellinglisboa](https://linktr.ee/storytellinglisboa)
